name: affinity
description: Create, inspect, edit, and preview Affinity documents through its native local MCP server, with guided Cavalry handoff, refresh, and visual comparison.

interface.shortDescription: Design and editing through Affinity's local MCP
interface.longDescription: A personal Codex plugin for Affinity's native MCP server. Includes SDK documentation, document scripting, previews, reusable scripts, and a planned handoff and refresh workflow for Cavalry. Keep Affinity open with its MCP server enabled.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable design in Affinity.
Plan an Affinity to Cavalry handoff for my open document.
Refresh my linked Affinity artwork in Cavalry and compare the previews.
